title: Tokyo Stock Exchange (JPX / TDnet) English Intelligence Input

tickers.title: TSE Stock Codes (Optional — empty fetches market-wide real-time TDnet)
tickers.description: 4-character JPX stock codes (e.g. ['7203', '9984', '8035', '6758'] or post-2024 alphanumeric ['130A']). Leave empty to stream the latest market-wide TDnet disclosures across all TSE Prime, Standard, and Growth companies.

maxDisclosures.title: Maximum TDnet Disclosures
maxDisclosures.description: Maximum number of real-time TDnet corporate disclosures to extract (1 to 200).

includeMarketQuotesAndMicrostructure.title: Enrich with Live .T JPY Quotes & Arrowhead Tick / S-taka S-yasu Price Limits
includeMarketQuotesAndMicrostructure.description: Attach live JPY market quote plus exact TOPIX500/Standard tick size, 34-tier daily stop-high (S-taka) & stop-low (S-yasu) bands, and JST session phase (including post-Nov-2024 15:30 Closing Itayose).

includeJpxAndBojMacroNews.title: Include Official JPX & Bank of Japan (BOJ) English Announcements
includeJpxAndBojMacroNews.description: Append latest official English releases from Japan Exchange Group (JPX) and Bank of Japan (BOJ).

eventCategoryFilter.title: Catalyst Category Filter (Optional)
eventCategoryFilter.description: Optional filter: EARNINGS_SUMMARY, GUIDANCE_REVISION, SHARE_BUYBACK, DIVIDEND_REVISION, TENDER_OFFER_MA, GOVERNANCE_CAPITAL_EFFICIENCY, MONTHLY_KPI, STOCK_SPLIT_OFFERING, OTHER_MATERIAL.
